intro.title: Sphatik Pyramids
intro.descriptionHtml: Wide range of genuine Sphatik Pyramids made from natural crystal gemstone. This colorless gemstone is also known as Clear Quartz. The healing properties of Sphatik have soothing, calming effect on the mind and body, it brings clarity, harmony, clears negative energies, promotes unity, hope and attracts Divine blessings. Pyramids are powerhouses of positive energies and move stagnant energies to flow. The dual effect of Sphatik gemstone and pyramid structure makes them the most desirable inclusion to be installed in homes or workspace.
